title: Beyond Reachability: A Relation-Semantic Reasoning Framework for Biomedical Multi-hop QA
abstract: arXiv:2610.19754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biomedical multi-hop reasoning over knowledge graphs requires identifying a semantically valid relation sequence that supports the answer. Existing methods can retrieve correct answers, yet often rank them poorly within a large pool of seemingly relevant candidates. Even when a correct answer is retrieved, its associated evidence and reasoning path may fail to support the relation composition required by the question. We term this disconnect between answer reachability and evidential validity the reachable-but-invalid problem. We present ReSemReason, which shares a question-induced distribution over typed, directed relation schemas between candidate discovery and evidence selection. Schema compatibility guides graph search; ReSemAttn then uses relation-conditioned key/value projections and an uncertainty-weighted path prior to attend to candidate-specific evidence. translated_title: 超越可达性：面向生物医学多跳问答的关系-语义推理框架
translated_abstract: 生物医学知识图谱上的多跳推理需要识别出一条语义有效的关系序列来支持答案。现有方法虽然能够检索到正确答案，但在大量看似相关的候选答案中往往排名不佳。即使检索到了正确答案，其相关证据和推理路径也可能无法支持问题所需的关系组合。我们将这种答案可达性与证据有效性之间的脱节称为“可达但无效”问题。我们提出了ReSemReason框架，它在候选发现与证据选择之间共享一个由问题诱导的类型化、有向关系模式分布。模式兼容性用于指导图搜索；随后ReSemAttn利用关系条件化的键/值投影和不确定性加权路径先验，关注针对特定候选的证据。当出现……时，一个独立的绝对支持度分数对归一化注意力进行了补充（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了ReSemReason框架，通过在候选发现与证据选择之间共享问题诱导的类型化关系模式分布，结合模式兼容性图搜索、关系条件化注意力机制和不确定性加权路径先验，解决了生物医学多跳问答中“答案可达但证据无效”的问题。
en_tdlr: ReSemReason tackles the "reachable-but-invalid" problem in biomedical multi-hop QA by sharing a question-induced distribution over typed relation schemas between candidate discovery and evidence selection, using schema compatibility to guide graph search and relation-conditioned attention with uncertainty-weighted path priors to attend to candidate-specific evidence.
